limitations: Only the reviewed numeric registry and prior string subset are admitted in targets; no state, history, loops, collections or nested requests. Numeric request bodies keep existing numeric/bool result restrictions.

Early floor/ceil return float, later int. Qualifier gaps and domain/overflow/zero-power decisions are explicitly adopted; power magnitude is binary64, with exact integral exponent parity. Old round and string formatter remain distinct.
Older artifact implementation identities still require recompilation; exact TradingView comparison remains separate.
